title: Chapter 196: Spiritual God Green Department Direct Army
content:
Chapter 196: Spiritual God Green Department Direct Army

Today, the lords of the alliance have tested the effect of the Heavenly Silkworm in their respective armies and witnessed the magic of this Zerg technique. Many lords could not resist the temptation and switched to the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations technique like Meng.

With powerful techniques, soldiers and excellent equipment, these lords of the alliance are looking forward to joining the war as soon as possible and quickly improving the strength of the territory army through the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations.

Wu Qing is also ready to give the alliance army some low-intensity opportunities to participate in the war. With the current causal relationship between the alliance and the Zerg, the enemy killed by the alliance army alone can already be converted into material energy and harvest resources by the system.

Wu Qing has been helping the various territories of the alliance, and deepening the causal relationship between the alliance and the Zerg is an important reason. Once this causal relationship is involved, it is difficult to get rid of it.

As for the question of how the alliance army can suddenly perform battlefield sacrifices, it only needs to be said that it is the protection of the Zerg master. It is normal that it is related to the great power and cannot be explained clearly.

After these alliance armies have been tempered on the battlefield, Wu Qing will equip the elite troops that stand out from the rest with Zerg biological colonization suits, and truly incorporate them into the Zerg system.

A batch of Zerg biological colonization suits have been traded with Gou Bao of the Tengu tribe. Under Gou Bao's soft and hard grinding, Wu Qing exchanged 500 sets of Zerg biological colonization suits for a batch of a considerable number of Qiyun beads.

This transaction was completed a few days ago under the arrangement of the Queen of Zerg.

Gou Bao got 500 sets of limited popular version Zerg biological colonization suits, and immediately bound them to a specially selected elite Tengu tribe troop, and as he said, began to train the troops.

The Qiyun beads obtained from the exchange have been absorbed by the system, and the converted Qi resources have been used up.

Therefore, this Zerg biological colonization suit is not a confidential equipment. Instead of replacing it in large quantities for the alliance, it is still purchasing equipment from the Goblin Chamber of Commerce because the production of Zerg biological colonization suits requires resources, especially the 1 point of Qi resources. If more equipment is replaced, the consumption of Qi resources is not a small amount.

At this stage, it is better to hatch more Zerg troops than to consume a lot of gas resources to arm the almost useless Alliance army. This is more cost-effective.

…

Wu Qing's Zerg clone stayed in Mengzhong City and did not return to the Zerg territory. Before dark, the Zerg Queen commanded the Zerg army fighting in the underground world to withdraw smoothly and return to the Zerg territory for rest.

Today's resource harvest in the underground world is almost two-thirds less than yesterday. The ghouls who rushed up desperately have disappeared, and the ghouls attacking the Zerg army's defense line have become sparse.

Only when the Zerg cockroaches and puppies rush out of the defense line and charge into the ghoul territory, those ghouls will be excited and launch a fierce counterattack for a period of time.

After leaving the Zerg defense line, the Zerg cockroaches and puppies will not fight against countless ghouls. With the support of the destroyer, they will withdraw to the Zerg defense line.

The ghouls fiercely attack the defense line. As long as they cannot attack for a long time, they will slack off and return to the beginning.

The battlefield of the underground world fell into such a tug-of-war, which greatly reduced the efficiency of the Zerg in killing enemies.

On the contrary, the Zerg flying dragons performed well. They avoided the gathering areas of underground rat archers and evil eyes, and could attack the ghoul territory unscrupulously, and reaped a lot of rewards.

"It is becoming more and more difficult to earn resources in the underground world!"

Wu Qing sighed, and then checked the reconnaissance of the Zerg puppies on the gathering area of the bear goblin army in the east of Guangfu City today.

Some information obtained from the words of the goblin elders made Wu Qing more eager to make a name for himself in the above world, rather than focusing on the underground world.

After a large number of Zerg puppies reconnaissance in the past few days, through some clues, the Zerg has found multiple military garrisons of the bear goblin tribe.

Through various signs, Wu Qing found that the bear goblin tribe was dispatching a large number of troops here. A total of more than a dozen garrisons of various sizes were found, and there should be more garrisons that have not been discovered.

The smallest of these garrisons has tens of thousands of regular troops. The total number of these troops added together would be a terrifying number.

Today, the Zerg puppy discovered a very special army of bear goblins at a large garrison, which aroused Wu Qing's vigilance.

These never-seen-before-seen bear goblin armies are all composed of bear goblins, and they are all equipped with a similar style of full-body armor.

These armors are all green, the same color as the skin color of the bear goblins, and look very strange.

Wu Qing has observed this army through the vision of the Zerg puppy. He can see that those green full-body armors are reasonably designed and completely fit the body structure of the bear goblins.

As long as the materials used for the armor are not too bad, this set of armor will have a very powerful effect on the combat power of the bear goblins.

The weapons he uses are different from those of ordinary bear goblin armies. They are no longer just sticks and javelins.

The temperament of this army is also different from that of ordinary bear goblin armies. In addition to the same fanaticism, it also gives people a sense of being good at fighting.

This army has about 300,000 soldiers gathered in a city. Wu Qing has a feeling that this army is targeting the Zerg.

Wu Qing has asked Wu Cong, Meng and Hu Wei, and they all said that they have never seen or heard of such a bugbear army.

The Queen of Zerg checked the information database, but there is no relevant record.

Gong Zhe from the Goblin Chamber of Commerce may know some information, but he is a businessman. In this world, intelligence information is an important commodity, so Wu Qing has not gone to him for the time being.

Wu Qing thought for a while, and the host No. 3, who was possessed by the Naga tribe, went to the Naga tribe's elder Naga in the Naga tribe's city.

As soon as Host No. 3 moved, Naga warriors came to help. Wu Qing expressed that he wanted to find Naga, so he was taken to Naga's residence.

Nagaya sensed the arrival of Host No. 3 from a distance. She put down her work and came out to see Host No. 3.

"No. 3, what's the matter? Do you need to come to me in person?"

Wu Qing said through Host No. 3: "Elder, our clan has discovered a new piece of information, which is of great importance. I have some questions that I would like to ask the elder for advice!"

Hearing Wu Qing say that there was important new information, Nagaya also became serious: "Please tell me!"

"Elders, do you know that the Bugbear clan has an army all wearing green armor?"

Wu Qing asked directly.

When Nagaya heard this, her expression became a little more solemn. She thought for a while and then said: "All of them are wearing green armor? The Bugbear clan?"

"Could it be the army directly under the Green Ministry of the Evil God?"

Nagaya replied with some uncertainty.

"What is Midori?"

Wu Qing asked.

"I once looked up relevant information about the bugbear clan in the tribe because it was next to the bugbear clan's sphere of influence."

"There is a record of information introducing the followers of the Evil God. It is said that in order to facilitate the management of believers, the Evil God divided the believers into many 'departments' and named them after colors."

"Among them, the bugbears are classified as green because of their skin color."

"The Bugbear clan is powerful and monopolizes the Green Department, and they are proud of it."

"They specially designed a set of green armor, and the equipment belongs directly to the army to show their glory!"

"The troops directly under the Green Ministry who are qualified to equip green armor are the true elite troops of the Bugbear clan!"

"Logically speaking, they shouldn't be in this area!"

"Did you get the information wrong?"

Nagaya looked at Host No. 3, somewhat doubting the authenticity of this information.

"Won't elite troops from all ethnic groups come over in this area?"

Wu Qing continued to ask.

"That's true. Don't ask me the reason, because I don't know either!"

"Maybe it's because of the remoteness!"

Nagaya knew what Wu Qing wanted to ask and interrupted in advance.

"If the bugbear army wearing green armor is really an army directly under the Green Ministry of the Evil God, there is an army directly under the Green Ministry with a size of about 300,000 stationed in the southeast of our location!"

Wu Qing said to Nagaya.

"How far is it from here?"

Seeing that Wu Qing was serious about what he said, Nagaa began to believe it.

"Elders, please don't worry. They are gathering directly opposite our clan's defense line. They are mainly targeting our clan!"

"I came here just to learn about the situation of this army from the elders!"

Wu Qing also wanted to know some specific conditions of this army.

Nagaya recalled it carefully and then said: "The records in that document are very simple. The description of the combat power of the army directly under the Green Ministry is only "Guarded by spiritual gods and green armor, they are invincible and invincible!" 'Take it with you!"

"Judging from my experience, even if they only have sub-star strength, with equipment and various blessings from evil gods, there will definitely be no problem against one-star troops!"

"So, you must be prepared to deal with this situation where you are about to face 300,000 enemies with at least one-star troops!"

"Are you sure? Do you need support from our clan?"

Nagaya said to Wu Qing.

If the Zerg intelligence is true, Nagaya no longer expects the Zerg reinforcements to continue to fight in the Naga territory. Perhaps she will use the little advantage she has just accumulated to support the Zerg.

With their lips dead and their teeth cold, the Zerg tribe was defeated, and the Naga tribe would not be easy either.

"If we only have the combat power of a one-star unit, our clan can fight!"

"If the nobles want to support, our clan can not withdraw the supporting troops in exchange for more luck beads from the nobles!"

"As long as we have enough luck, our clan is not afraid of the army directly under the Green Ministry!"

Wu Qing learned that the combat power of the 300,000 troops directly under the Green Ministry was comparable to that of a one-star unit. Coupled with the blessings of the evil god priests, the Zerg would definitely suffer heavy losses if they tried to rely on the insect sea tactics to fight head-on.

He planned to upgrade the star level of a group of Zerg core combat forces to deal with this army, which required a large amount of Qi resources.
